post.text:
Qwen3.5-35B-A3B UD-Q3_K_XL 3090 vs M3 Ultra with Llamacpp

I've finally installed Linux on my PC with RTX 3090 and I'm ready to do some perf tests versus M3 Ultra 512GB.
Results
For this first one I went for llama-bench using the amazing UD-Q3_K_XL quantized GGUF from @UnslothAI and... Spoiler: 
🥇 3090
🥈 M3 Ultra 
BUT... MLX is much faster compared to llamacpp as you can see from my previous article here. So we need to take these results with a grain of salt.
Look at the charts here and tables for detail comparison
 
 
This should be a table, but X Articles don't support markdown or tables yet.
I leave it here in md style, while waiting for @nikitabier to fix this 🤭
--- Prefill Speedup: RTX 3090 vs M3 Ultra ---
Tokens | RTX 3090 t/s | M3 Ultra t/s | Speedup
----------------------------------------------
256    | 1911.84      | 1365.67      | 1.40x  
512    | 2551.71      | 1721.94      | 1.48x  
1024   | 2523.80      | 1708.32      | 1.48x  
2048   | 2501.85      | 1702.84      | 1.47x  
4096   | 2454.99      | 1674.11      | 1.47x  
8192   | 2362.39      | 1599.86      | 1.48x  
16384  | 2223.85      | 1467.74      | 1.52x  
32768  | 1939.89      | 1230.07      | 1.58x  
65536  | 1452.91      | 832.85       | 1.74x  
--- Decode Speedup: RTX 3090 vs M3 Ultra ---
Tokens | RTX 3090 t/s | M3 Ultra t/s | Speedup
----------------------------------------------
128    | 111.92       | 57.35        | 1.95x  
256    | 112.53       | 57.52        | 1.96x  
512    | 111.82       | 57.54        | 1.94x  
1024   | 111.79       | 56.92        | 1.96x  
2048   | 111.15       | 56.61        | 1.96x  
4096   | 109.66       | 55.60        | 1.97x  
8192   | 107.19       | 54.39        | 1.97x  
Next steps
Clearly the difference in speed between llamacpp implementation and MLX  on these @Alibaba_Qwen QWEN3.5 Medium models is so relevant that we need to figure out a different way to compare the two platform.
I will try to use MLX on CUDA to see if we can something different. 
Stay tuned!
